description: Checks up to 5 references against public registries: DOI through Crossref, arXiv ids through the arXiv API, ISBN-10/13 through Open Library (checksum first). Returns title, year, venue and a BibTeX entry plus an APA-style string for each verified one; unknown ones come back as not_found. Authors are given for DOI and arXiv only. Choose this tool for: Checks up to 5 references against public registries: DOI. Close alternatives on this server: agent_intel_agent_json_schema_guard (Checks an agent's JSON output against a JSON Schema); agent_intel_hallucination_claim_checker (Checks the named entities in an AI answer against Wikidata). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
